message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the facts.

Facts: Person applied for a credit card, then from April 2015 multiple large malicious overdrafts (i.e., credit card fraud). Bank repeatedly demanded repayment, but he didn't pay. By May 2, 2017, total overdue principal 99,996.53 yuan. After the case, he and relatives repaid principal, interest, penalty fully.

Thus the crime is credit card fraud, i.e., "信用卡诈骗". In earlier examples, they used "信用卡诈骗". For similar case: earlier example with credit card malicious overdraft: they gave answer "信用卡诈骗". So single charge.

Check if any other charge like "拒不执行判决、裁定" but he repaid, so not. So answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗<eoa>
